products.name: Emerald Temple-Border Kanjivaram
products.description: A deep emerald body with a broad antique-gold temple border and a gold-on-green brocade pallu. The weight of a true Kanjivaram, made to be worn on Lakshmi Puja night and passed down after.
details: 6.3 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece
products.care: Dry clean only. Store folded in a muslin cloth and refold every few months.

products.name: Peacock Blue Korvai Kanjivaram
products.colour: Peacock blue with maroon and gold
products.description: Peacock blue meets a maroon korvai border, joined by hand in the traditional interlocked weave. The contrast pallu is brocaded with gold mango motifs that shimmer as you move.
details: 6.3 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece
products.care: Dry clean only. Keep away from perfume and direct sunlight.

products.name: Wine Purple Kanjivaram with Gold Pallu
products.colour: Wine purple with olive and gold
products.description: A jewel-toned wine body with an olive-and-gold border and a heavy all-gold pallu. One of the richest weaves in our Diwali edit, for the evening you light the first diya.
details: 6.3 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece
products.care: Dry clean only. Wrap in muslin; do not hang for long periods.

products.name: Copper Tissue Kanjivaram
products.description: Burnt copper silk woven with a fine gold tissue weft, so the whole saree glows like a lamp flame. Wear it for Dhanteras gold shopping and again for the puja.
details: 6.3 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece
products.care: Dry clean only. Iron on low heat from the reverse.

products.name: Ivory & Parrot Green Kanjivaram
products.description: A silver-ivory body with a bright parrot-green border and pallu. Fresh and festive for the morning puja, and quietly grand by lamplight.
details: 6.3 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece

products.name: Saffron Zari Katan Banarasi
products.description: The colour of marigold garlands and diya flames. A pure katan silk Banarasi with a dense gold zari border and buttis scattered across the body.
details: 6.2 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece
products.care: Dry clean only. Store with neem leaves or silica, never with naphthalene.

products.name: Sindoor Red Banarasi Brocade
products.colour: Sindoor red with coral and gold
products.description: Sindoor red shading into coral, brocaded in gold with a classic Banarasi jaal. The most-asked-for colour for Lakshmi Puja, and the one that photographs best by lamplight.
details: 6.2 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece

products.name: Lotus Pink Katan Banarasi
products.description: The pink of the lotus Maa Lakshmi stands on. Soft katan silk with fine silver-gold floral buttis and a woven border that frames the drape.
details: 6.2 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece

products.name: Mint & Blush Kora Banarasi
products.description: A pastel kora silk Banarasi in mint, with a wide blush-pink border and pallu woven with silver lotus motifs. Light enough to wear from evening puja to late-night card parties.

products.name: Midnight Blue Banarasi Silk
products.description: Like the Amavasya sky on Diwali night: midnight-blue silk scattered with silver zari motifs. A striking choice when everyone else is in red and gold.
details: 6.2 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece

products.name: Kumkum Red Banarasi Georgette
products.description: A fluid Banarasi georgette in kumkum red with large gold zari motifs. Falls beautifully, travels well, and is easy to drape on a busy festival day.

products.name: Marigold Soft Silk, Rani Pink Border

details: 6.2 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece

products.name: Ivory Gold Tissue Kasavu

details: 6.2 m with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece

products.name: Blush Chanderi Silk-Cotton
